title: CTAD from a C Array
prompt: Add to `Stats` an array constructor that scans for the real min/max, and the deduction guide so `Stats s{arr};` deduces `Stats<int>` from `int arr[]`.

tests.name: guide + constructor deduce and scan
tests.hint:
template <std::size_t N> Stats(const T (&a)[N]) : min(a[0]), max(a[0]) { for (std::size_t i = 1; i < N; ++i) { if (a[i] < min) min = a[i]; if (a[i] > max) max = a[i]; } }
template <class T, std::size_t N> Stats(const T (&)[N]) -> Stats<T>;

tests.name: pair constructor still works
tests.hint: Do not break the original constructor — CTAD tries all guides.
